The SIT probing a possible terror link in the arson near a synagogue in Ernakulam market has found that the accused was allegedly involved in two similar incidents earlier this year, police sources said on Monday (October 19, 2026).
Police have arrested Ebin Paul (32), a native of Puthencruz near here, for allegedly setting fire to Blossom Nursery, located in front of the Kadavubhagam synagogue in Ernakulam market, within the limits of Kochi Central police station, in the early hours of October 12.
On Monday (October 19), Mr. Paul was produced before the Ernakulam Judicial First Class Magistrate Court after the completion of five days of police custody and was remanded to judicial custody.
According to sources, the investigation revealed that Paul first attempted to set fire to a building at Mekkappad in Muvattupuzha in January and targeted the same place in March this year. The building, which housed an office, suffered minor damage, police said.
The Special Investigation Team (SIT) suspects that videos of the incident were sent to his handlers through Telegram.
Later, Mr. Paul allegedly set fire to a used-car showroom in Muvattupuzha before the arson near the synagogue in Kochi, police said.
During the investigation, Mr. Paul was taken to all three locations and his residence for evidence collection, officials said.
The probe into electronic devices used by Paul is progressing, with investigators attempting to identify his alleged handlers, police said.
Based on the findings, fresh charges will be added to the case, and the SIT will seek his custody again, they added.
Meanwhile, Puthencruz police, which registered a separate case after drugs, including heroin, oxycodone, fentanyl, alprazolam and ketamine, were seized from Mr. Paul's residence, will soon record his arrest and approach the court seeking his custody.
Central agencies, including the National Investigation Agency (NIA), have already collected information from the police about the case, officials said.
